recipes.label: Relax arm bends and wrists
recipes.expectedChange: Sets elbow swivels to 90/-90 and wrists to -6/+6 on every existing human pose key. Wrist anchors, other channels, timing and speech stay authored; grip orientation may change.
checks: Inspect shoulder and elbow bends before and after.
Inspect held objects, grips and hand contacts throughout the shot.
Confirm pose key times and the source clock are unchanged.

recipes.label: Use tailored clothing
recipes.expectedChange: Uses the existing joint-aware tailored garment renderer. The anatomy study's shorts are not replaced.
checks: Inspect sleeve and trouser joints through the motion.
Inspect garment overlap and folds in the selected view.

recipes.label: Use angular face construction
recipes.expectedChange: Selects the existing angular native face while retaining gaze, expression and speech controls.
checks: Inspect jaw, cheeks and facial-feature visibility.
Inspect gaze, blinks and speaking poses in native previews.

recipes.label: Use soft face construction
recipes.expectedChange: Selects the existing soft native face without changing expression channels or dialogue timing.
checks: Inspect eyelids, nose, lips and jaw in the selected view.
Inspect expressions and speaking poses before choosing this candidate.

recipes.label: Use soft surface shading
recipes.expectedChange: Enables the existing native soft surface shading with the actor's current light angle and colors.
checks: Inspect native shading around joints and overlapping parts.
Confirm facial features and garment contours remain readable.

recipes.label: Use long hair
recipes.expectedChange: Selects the existing long-hair geometry while preserving hair color, figure style, poses and speech.
checks: Inspect hair, ear and neck overlap in the selected view.
Inspect shoulder clearance through head and body movement.

recipes.label: Add a natural blink track
recipes.expectedChange: Adds the existing native default blink track only when no blink track is present. Body pose keys, authored blink channels and speech timing are preserved.
checks: Inspect eyelid closure and reopening over the shot.
Inspect interaction with existing pose expressions and gaze.
Confirm dialogue and body key timing are unchanged.

recipes.label: Use pale graphite study colors
recipes.expectedChange: Sets pale skin, graphite hair and neutral gray shorts in the native anatomy study. Canvas background, geometry and animation stay unchanged.
checks: Inspect line and skin contrast against the current background.
Inspect hair and shorts readability at the intended output size.

recipes.label: Use cel hand rendering
recipes.expectedChange: Selects the existing native cel hand surfaces and contours, retaining the hand's pose programme and colors.
checks: Inspect finger roots, nails and skin silhouette.
Inspect curled and open poses for gaps and overlap errors.

recipes.label: Use smooth hand rendering
recipes.expectedChange: Selects the existing native smooth hand renderer without changing joint controls or timing.
checks: Inspect surface shading and finger joints.
Inspect skin continuity through the complete pose programme.

recipes.label: Show anatomical hand detail
recipes.expectedChange: Uses the existing anatomical hand-detail setting; the selected surface renderer and animation are retained.
checks: Inspect palm creases, knuckles and nails.
Inspect detail readability at the intended output size.

recipes.label: Use contour hand detail
recipes.expectedChange: Uses the existing contour hand-detail setting without replacing the hand's poses or surface style.
checks: Inspect finger silhouettes and palm readability.
Inspect open and closed poses before accepting this candidate.
